changes_since_initial_sweep.fix: Generator-side max-grade clamp for elevation profiles. New env UP_ELEVATION_MAX_GRADE (default 0.2) clamps the endpoint-based linear-grade b coefficient at the computation site AND defensively inside _set_flat_elevation, so no generated single-segment profile can exceed the checker threshold. Clamped road ids recorded in QC report (grade_clamped_road_ids / grade_clamped_count / max_grade).
changes_since_initial_sweep.verification: tests/unit/test_elevation_grade_clamp.py (3 tests): default clamp 3.0->0.2; UP_ELEVATION_MAX_GRADE=10 keeps 3.0; gentle 0.15 not clamped. All pass.
changes_since_initial_sweep.note: Applies on next canonical regen (blocked on SUMO). Current candidate still carries 74 single-segment roads with |b|>0.2 (worst road 68944, b=1.004105).

changes_since_initial_sweep.fix: Width-jump comparison now skips adjacent lane sections where the lane's type changes (e.g. sidewalk <-> driving). The single initial-sweep issue (road 46620, lane 1, 2.0 m sidewalk -> 3.5 m driving at s=0.05, delta 1.5 m) was a lane-identity change, not a width jump; comparing widths across it was a false positive.
Same lane-type-transition guard applied to the lane_width sub-check, matching FIX-2.
